question: In Ball Badminton, players change the ends in each game when a side first scores all of the following, EXCEPT:
solution:
The correct answer is __**11.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ball Badminton is a fast-paced racket sport **played on a rectangular court.
 
• It shares similarities with traditional badminton but uses a smaller, heavier ball made of **wool**.
 
• Played singles or doubles, teams aim to hit the ball over the net and into the opponent's court, scoring points when the opposing team fails to return the ball.
 
• **Points are awarded for faults, including failing to return the ball, hitting it out of bounds, or committing foot faults.**
 
• Changing ends occurs when a team reaches a **certain point threshold**, ensuring fair play.
 
• In **Ball Badminton**, **players switch ends of the court after each game when a side reaches 11 points** with a two-point lead.
 
• The only exception to changing ends after 11 points is when the score reaches 9-9. In this case, the game continues until one side gains a two-point lead 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ball Badminton is played with a **yellow-coloured ball**.
 
• The yellow ball is used for better visibility during gameplay.
 
• It distinguishes the ball from the surroundings and facilitates tracking during fast-paced movements.
 
• The colour helps players react swiftly and accurately during matches.
